Guido van Rossum recalls starting Python during the 1989 Christmas holidays while working in CWI's Amoeba group and seeking a generally extensible scripting language for needs that included system administration. This is van Rossum's attributed retrospective account, preserved in the 3.13.0 release's FAQ. The account distinguishes his work setting and the motivating use case from the generally extensible design and his early development largely on his own time.
